# datadog_integration_claude_compliance_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Claude Compliance integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the Claude Compliance integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Claude Compliance integration account.

### Read-Only

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from Claude Compliance, keyed by dataflow ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `claude_compliance_integration_account_bearer_token_auth` (Attributes) The bearer token authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--claude_compliance_integration_account_bearer_token_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--claude_compliance_integration_account_bearer_token_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.claude_compliance_integration_account_bearer_token_auth`

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `bearer_token`. Defaults to `"bearer_token"`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret token used to authenticate with Claude Compliance. Exactly one of `token` or `token_wo` must be set. Prefer `token_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `token_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret token used to authenticate with Claude Compliance. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `token_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for token_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Read-Only:

- `anthropic_compliance_logs` (Attributes) Audit activity logs from the Anthropic Compliance API, such as SSO sign-ins, API key lifecycle events, member and role changes, and Claude chat and file access. [Cloud SIEM](https://docs.datadoghq.com/security/cloud_siem/) uses these logs to detect security-sensitive activity. Requires an Anthropic Enterprise plan with the Compliance API enabled in the organization's Data and privacy settings. Without it, this dataflow collects no data. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, so it appears in responses only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--anthropic_compliance_logs))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--anthropic_compliance_logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.anthropic_compliance_logs`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Always `true`, because this collection cannot be turned off.
- `status` (Attributes) Read-only collection status of a dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--anthropic_compliance_logs--status))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--anthropic_compliance_logs--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.anthropic_compliance_logs.status`

Read-Only:

- `health` (String) Collection health of a single dataflow.
- `message` (String) Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.
- `updated_at` (String) Time the status was last computed.
